import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Aggregate the number of dogs by district and breed
breed_district = data.groupby(['KreisLang', 'Rasse1Text']).size().reset_index(name='Count')

# Pivot the table for heatmap
heatmap_data = breed_district.pivot('KreisLang', 'Rasse1Text', 'Count').fillna(0)

# Create the heatmap
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.heatmap(heatmap_data, cmap='YlGnBu', linewidths=.5)

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Breed and District in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Breed', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('District', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')

# Save the plot as a PNG file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
